 I Scrolled Lululemon’s Black Friday Sale—These Are the Top 20 Picks Worth Shopping 
 Follow Apparel & Footwear View feed I Scrolled Lululemon’s Black Friday Sale—These Are the Top 20 Picks Worth Shopping 
 From Align leggings to cute Define jackets, and half off select Everywhere Belt Bags. 
 By Anvita Reddy Published: Nov 19, 2026 9:54 AM EST Save Article Share Article We've been independently researching and testing products for over 120 years. If you buy through our links, we may earn a commission. Learn more about our review process. 
 2 min read Lululemon’s official Black Friday sale kicks off today, with markdowns across the brand’s lineup of top-tested activewear. You might be tempted to wait for November 27 to get your holiday shopping done, but considering this is one of just two Lululemon sales of the entire year, our editors suspect the best finds will sell out fast.
 Shop Lululemon’s Black Friday Sale 
 Shop the brand’s most beloved activewear while it’s up to 50% off, including Lululemon’s buttery-soft Align leggings and Wunder Train tights . Both are among the best leggings our experts at the Good Housekeeping Institute’s Textiles Lab have tested. Now’s also a good time to stock up on winter base layers and cozy loungewear, like the popular Scuba line; Textiles Lab Associate Director Emma Seymour says she wears her Scuba half-zip hoodie “almost every day.”
 I scrolled through the sale and found the activewear worth considering, including bestsellers and gift-worthy favorites. We’ll also keep this story updated with fresh picks if Lululemon releases any more Black Friday deals in the coming weeks.

 Now 28% Off $68 $49 at Lululemon One of the best places to start stocking your cart is Lululemon’s leggings section. Emma Seymour , who tested over 30 pairs of leggings to determine her rankings, loves the flattering fit of both the Align and Wunder Train styles.
 “If I’m heading to the gym, these are my go-to tights,” Seymour says of the Wunder Train high rise tight. “Whether I'm lifting weights, jogging on the treadmill, or doing a core workout, the waistband stays put without digging in, thanks to the hidden drawcord.”
 Lululemon’s Align fabric is also worth considering, whether you’re looking for a gift or shopping for yourself—and several different styles like the racerback tank top , the iconic Align leggings , and the Define Jacket are included in the Black Friday sale. Seymour prefers the Define Jacket for chillier days: “It's super comfortable to wear and stretches with you during movement," Seymour says. "I especially like the flattering seams that hug the jacket to your body and the thumb holes."
 Lululemon hasn’t said exactly when its Black Friday sale will end, but we suspect our favorite styles will sell out well before the event wraps. Shop the rare sale while your size is still in stock.
